runtime.divan_sample_policy: sample_count, sample_size and max_time remain those in the hash-pinned workload; actual samples and iterations are retained in each transcript

confidence.assumptions: independent observations within each order stratum, identically distributed within each stratum; continuous positive ratio distributions; target is the geometric mean of the two population medians, not a mean or pooled median

quiescence.sustained_checks: Record initial and final host identity, each block boundary, and each owned process. Background load does not reject measurements or permit retries.
quiescence.concurrent_measurement_policy: The capture owns the exclusive machine lock. No other task-owned performance capture runs concurrently.

resource_counters.elapsed_scope: Compile measurements stop at successful Cargo exit. Runtime measurements include natural exit of all descendants. Each process receipt also retains full cleanup time.
resource_counters.direct_process_scope: Raw counters cover only the direct process. Cargo child CPU, memory and instructions are not inferred.

absolute_compatibility.reason: Windows relative measurements do not qualify the 33 macOS absolute budgets. Those budgets and their separate evidence remain unchanged.

common_workloads.policy: controller-owned hash-pinned consumer sources on exact archived product revisions; no product implementation overlays
common_workloads.ancestry: exact revision and tree identity; shared ancestry is not required after the approved clean-slate history
common_workloads.historical_budget_provenance: unchanged v5 document retains original workload hashes; original and effective source hashes are recorded separately
common_workloads.compile_target_lifetime: unique clean target per sample; delete completed check-only targets after transcript and resource capture
common_workloads.setup_boundary: Each cancellation leaf signals its first poll. All signalling handles are dropped before cancellation timing starts.

interleaving.acceptance: both modes must pass in the same authenticated capture

compiler_cleanup_policy.admission: Only check or bench --no-run calls to the pinned Cargo executable can use compiler cleanup. The runner checks the telemetry executable hash before and after capture.
compiler_cleanup_policy.cleanup: After successful Cargo exit, the runner can stop only the pinned telemetry executable inside the owned job. Any other live descendant immediately rejects the measurement.
compiler_cleanup_policy.evidence: The receipt retains both elapsed times and every terminated telemetry process. A failed command or incomplete cleanup rejects the measurement.
